title: VortexChat: An agentic framework for autonomous multi-objective integrated photonic design
abstract: arXiv:2608.20688v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The advancement of modern integrated photonics is frequently bottlenecked by device design workflows that rely heavily on manual simulation and expert intuition. While inverse design offers an alternative, it remains constrained by expert supervision and a lack of end-to-end automation. To address these issues, we present VortexChat, an agentic framework for the autonomous, end-to-end inverse design of integrated photonic devices directly from natural language specifications. VortexChat couples a large language model (LLM) decision agent with topology generation, gradient-based refinement, and full-wave electromagnetic simulation. This closed-loop architecture enables the system to iteratively decompose design objectives, orchestrate computational tools, and update strategies based on feedback with minimal human intervention. translated_title: VortexChat：一个用于自主多目标集成光子设计的智能体框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20688v1 公告类型：新 摘要：现代集成光子学的发展常常受到依赖手动仿真和专家直觉的设备设计工作流程的瓶颈限制。虽然逆向设计提供了一种替代方案，但仍受限于专家监督和缺乏端到端自动化。为解决这些问题，我们提出了VortexChat，一个智能体框架，用于直接从自然语言规范进行集成光子器件的自主、端到端逆向设计。VortexChat将大语言模型（LLM）决策智能体与拓扑生成、基于梯度的优化和全波电磁仿真相结合。这种闭环架构使系统能够迭代分解设计目标、编排计算工具，并根据反馈更新策略，只需最少的人工干预。受Vortex100基准的绝对指标约束，VortexChat自主生成稳定的器件。
tldr: 该论文提出了VortexChat，一个结合大语言模型决策智能体与拓扑生成和全波仿真的闭环智能体框架，实现了从自然语言规范到集成光子器件设计的自主端到端逆向设计，显著减少了人工干预。
en_tdlr: The paper presents VortexChat, a closed-loop agentic framework combining an LLM decision agent with topology generation and full-wave simulation, enabling autonomous end-to-end inverse design of integrated photonic devices from natural language specifications with minimal human intervention.
